findings.title: Universe /dashboard no longer renders for anonymous users (HTTP 307 → /login)
findings.whats_wrong: Live /dashboard returns 307 Location: /login?next=%2Fdashboard. Capture shows login form, 0 canvases, no Universe/3D. Prior capture 2026-11-01 rendered "Adrian's Mind · Universe" with bot constellation. Sidebar still advertises Dashboard as a primary workspace destination.
findings.repro: curl -sI https://adrians-mind.vercel.app/dashboard → 307 to /login?next=%2Fdashboard; Playwright goto /dashboard lands on login; canvasCount=0
evidence: live-vercel-2026-11-01/dashboard-desktop-meta had title Universe and body with Conductor/Gap Dispatcher nodes
findings.code_notes: preview/ui-completion src/routes/dashboard.tsx uses requireDashboardUser() fail-closed → /login; component is CommandApp (not DashboardApp). deploy worktree still has ungated DashboardApp — live matches auth gate.
findings.also_related: dashboard-3d.lock claimed by Dashboard Bot — lane contradiction (3D vs auth-gated CommandApp)
findings.user_impact: Primary advertised 3D dashboard is unreachable without sign-in; guests see login wall instead of Universe.

findings.title: Cannot verify 3D nodes/charts render on live dashboard (auth wall blocks audit)
findings.whats_wrong: Lane 2 headless audit cannot confirm whether signed-in users still get DashboardApp 3D or the ui-completion CommandApp swap. Zero canvases observed; asset network for dashboard-3d/art/* never requested on live /dashboard.
findings.repro: Unauthenticated Playwright session → redirected; do not sign in per REA rules. Recorded as blocked.
evidence: network never fetched /dashboard-3d/art/* during dashboard probe
findings.user_impact: Unknown whether production 3D still ships behind auth; high risk of silent swap to CommandApp.

findings.title: Heavy brand/3D/avatar assets still served from same-origin /public (pending Media migration)
findings.whats_wrong: Network+DOM show assets loaded as https://adrians-mind.vercel.app/brand/... and /avatars/... and (in repo) public/dashboard-3d/art/*. No Supabase signed URLs. GET /api/mind/media/asset-url?key=brand/logo-mark.jpg → 404. Per Media Storage Fleet: classify as pending_migration, not broken.
findings.repro: Load /; DevTools/network shows /brand/logo-mark.jpg, frost-card-texture.jpg, hero-mono-grain.jpg from app origin. curl asset-url → 404 Not Found.

findings.user_impact: Larger TTFB/bundle coupling; migration planned. Not user-broken today.

findings.title: Effort Fast/Expert/Heavy UI advertises tiers that do not change the model
findings.whats_wrong: UI copy: "This effort is not wired to a different model." Code comment in command-app: "Effort does not change model tier. The server model stays on the Direct path." Controls look like model/effort pickers but are cosmetic path labels.
findings.repro: Open / Chat; click Fast/Expert/Heavy; read helper text under composer.
findings.user_impact: Users believe they select model power; behavior unchanged — trust/UX contradiction.

findings.title: Connector/MCP status panels require sign-in (401) — honest banners present
findings.whats_wrong: 6× OAuth status endpoints 401; UI shows "Status unavailable (sign in required)" and MCP list "Sign in is required" with Retry/View log/Dismiss. Not a silent empty. Previously locked by error-banners (done/released).
findings.repro: Load / signed out; see banner + Connected cards.
findings.user_impact: Signed-out users cannot read connector status — expected until auth; banners are honest.

findings.title: Deep-link URL routes for SPA views 404 (/settings,/library,/projects,/voice,/mcp,/tools,/chat,/command,/app,/artifacts,/connectors)
findings.whats_wrong: Only real app routes live: /, /login, /dashboard (gated), /explore, /memory, /personas→/explore. Sidebar items are in-app views except Dashboard link. Bookmarking /settings returns tiny 404 shell (1354 bytes).
findings.repro: curl -sI each path → 404 for listed routes; 200 for / explore memory login.
findings.user_impact: Low unless users expect shareable URLs; in-app nav works.

findings.title: Generate Image / Generate Video quick actions disabled when unsigned/unconfigured
findings.selector: Quick actions Generate Image / Generate Video
findings.whats_wrong: Buttons present but disabled=true. Imagine control remains available. Honest disabled, not dead-click.
findings.repro: Home Chat; inspect Generate Image/Video disabled attribute.
findings.user_impact: Low — disabled state prevents false starts.

findings.title: Login surface expanded (email/password + Google/GitHub/Apple/X)
findings.whats_wrong: Not broken — delta vs Nov1 (Google+X only). Recorded for awareness; visual-polish-login previously worked this area.
findings.user_impact: Positive expansion; auth still required for owner features.
